description: Governor's Office - Western Province - By - Laws on Urban Councils; Kesbewa, Boralesgamuwa, Minuwangoda and Beruwala
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration and publication of a by-law (specifically the "By law relating to Procedure for the Conduct of Business at Meetings of the Urban Council") that has received the Governor's assent. It establishes legal procedures and regulatory frameworks for how urban council meetings should be conducted, including meeting schedules, notice requirements, quorum rules, and procedural guidelines. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates subsidiary legislation under the Urban Councils Ordinance and Provincial Councils Act.
